how_to_apply: Download the advertisement and prescribed application form from dor.gov.in or cestat.gov.in.
Fill the biodata in the prescribed proforma at Annexure-I with a photograph signed by the candidate.

Serving officers, including Judicial Officers, attach Annexure-II certificate, attested CR/APAR photocopies of at least last five years, cadre clearance, Annexure-III vigilance clearance and a penalty statement.
Send the application to Shri Tarandeep Singh, Under Secretary (Ad.1C), Department of Revenue, Kartavya Bhawan-1, New Delhi.
The application must reach the office latest by 16.12.2026.

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: Is, or has been, a member of the Indian Revenue Service (Customs and Indirect Taxes Group 'A'), has held the post of Principal Commissioner of Customs or Central Excise, or an equivalent or higher post, and has performed judicial, quasi-judicial or adjudicating functions for three years. Experience required: Has performed judicial, quasi-judicial or adjudicating functions for three years. Pay: Rs. 2,25,000 (fixed). Qualification required: Is, or has been, a District Judge and Additional District Judge for a combined period of ten years; or; Has been an advocate for ten years with substantial experience in litigation under indirect tax laws before CESTAT or High Court or the Supreme Court; or; Is, or has been, a member of the Indian Legal Service in Grade I or above. Experience required: As included in the qualification options. Pay: Rs. 2,25,000 (fixed).

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Term of five years or till the age of Sixty-Seven years, whichever is earlier No additional pension, provident fund or gratuity for services rendered in the Tribunal Selected candidate declares to join within 30 days from the date of issue of the appointment order

content_sections.heading: How Will CESTAT Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Comprehensive assessment by the Search-Cum-Selection Committee, including personal interaction with the candidates Search-Cum-Selection Committee makes a comprehensive assessment based on weightage specified in the regulation Includes personal interaction with the candidates Considers integrity, suitability and the requirement of the Tribunal

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Biodata in the prescribed proforma at Annexure-I with a photograph duly signed by the candidate Serving officers: Certificate from employer / head of office / forwarding authority as in Annexure-II Serving officers: Clear photocopies of up-to-date CR/APAR dossier of at least last five years attested by a Group A officer Serving officers: Cadre clearance and integrity / vigilance clearance as in Annexure-III Serving officers: Statement of major or minor penalties imposed during the last ten years Copy of 02 adjudicating orders (Judges/ILS and IRS officers); proof of experience (non-government); latest ITR copy (advocates)

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Applicants under the earlier vacancy circular dated 15.04.2026 must apply afresh No TA/DA for candidates called for interview/interaction Candidate declares not to withdraw candidature after the Selection Committee meeting nor decline appointment if selected by the ACC Violating declaration conditions may lead to debarment for three years from appointment outside the cadre and in autonomous, statutory or regulatory bodies

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CESTAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 16 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CESTAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 9 vacancies: 5 Member (Technical), 4 Member (Judicial).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for CESTAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-I of this circular; also downloadable from dor.gov.in or cestat.gov.in) and send it to Shri Tarandeep Singh, Under Secretary (Ad.1C), Department of Revenue, Room No. 14108, 4th Floor, 'C' Wing, Kartavya Bhawan-1, New Delhi- 110 001, to reach by 16 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 2,25,000 (fixed) for Member (Technical), Rs. 2,25,000 (fixed) for Member (Judicial).

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Member (Judicial): District Judge and Additional District Judge for a combined ten years, or advocate for ten years with substantial indirect tax litigation experience before CESTAT, High Court or Supreme Court, or member of Indian Legal Service in Grade I or above. Member (Technical): member of IRS (Customs and Indirect Taxes Group 'A') who has held the post of Principal Commissioner of Customs or Central Excise or an equivalent or higher post, with three years of judicial, quasi-judicial or. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. A serving Supreme Court or High Court Judge, or serving member of any Central or State government service or undertaking, must resign or take voluntary retirement before joining. Pay of an appointee receiving pension is reduced by the gross amount of pension drawn. A person holding or who has held the post of Member in CESTAT is eligible for reappointment under Section 14 of the Act.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications received after the due date will not be entertained. Applications without the necessary Annexure will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Comprehensive assessment by the Search-Cum-Selection Committee, including personal interaction with the candidates. Search-Cum-Selection Committee makes a comprehensive assessment based on weightage specified in the regulation. Includes personal interaction with the candidates. Considers integrity, suitability and the requirement of the Tribunal.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Term of five years or till the age of Sixty-Seven years, whichever is earlier. No additional pension, provident fund or gratuity for services rendered in the Tribunal. Selected candidate declares to join within 30 days from the date of issue of the appointment order.

faq.question: Q10. Which places are covered by CESTAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Ahmedabad, Mumbai, Kolkata, Hyderabad, Bangalore, Delhi, Chandigarh, Any Bench of the Tribunal.
